title: A resolution designating the first week of April as "National Asbestos Awareness Week".
latestAction: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S1690; text: CR S1675)
summary:
This resolution designates the first week of April as National Asbestos Awareness Week.

It also urges the Office of the Surgeon General to warn and educate people about asbestos exposure, which may be hazardous to their health.
